description: GROUND_CONCERN SIX KINDS, Path 2 (GROUND_CONCERN_SIX_KINDS_PREREG.md, GROUND_CONCERN_SIX_KINDS_RESULTS.md): a promoted `self_account` StandingConcern was MEASURED to fall through jabberwock_daemon._concern_tick's generic induce_concern/ground_concern fallback into the SAME inert comprehend_describe_directive_<tag> rule A25 found for prog_read (or, on the rare content-triggered case, the equally-mismatched ARC vary/gradient self-improvement bundle -- self_account is not in _promote_relations_for_concern's conversation-experiment kind list, so it has NO safe existing pipeline value to defer to). `_concern_tick` now routes EVERY StandingConcern of this kind (unconditionally -- unlike knowledge/reply_fix there is no safe pipeline value to spare) DIRECTLY into domains.self_account_growth.work_on_self_account_gap, which re-checks the EXISTING SelfProcess account lookup (domains.self_model.find_self_process, CLAUDE.md's own 'self_processes' section) instead of inventing or fabricating a mechanism. `_process_self_account_standing` records a MECHANICAL outcome datum (self_account_compose_ok / self_account_compose_reason) onto the StandingConcern -- never a decision there. THIS seed's two rules read that datum: `resolve_self_account_gap` (the resolve_code_write_gap precedent) marks the original SelfConcern resolved when a held SelfProcess account for the topic now exists; `note_self_account_composition_exhausted` (the note_prog_read_composition_exhausted precedent) marks the StandingConcern experiments_exhausted with the honest, specific reason (no held account, authoring one is an architecture-documentation task -- never auto-fabricated) when it does not. No emitter tool exists for this file (confirmed by grep across tools/*.py) -- hand-authored, the same status code_write_gap.json/prog_read_gap.json already have.
